description: This header file declares functions related to integrating Lua values with the lighttpd server, including conversions between Lua stack values and server-internal value representations.

methods.name: li_lua_init_value_mt
methods.description: Initializes the Lua metatable for value objects.

methods.name: li_value_from_lua
methods.description: Converts the value at the top of the Lua stack into an internal liValue object and pops it.

methods.name: li_lua_push_value
methods.description: Pushes an internal liValue object onto the Lua stack; returns 1 on success or nil on error.

methods.name: li_lua_togstring
methods.description: Converts a Lua value at a given index to a GString representation.
